name: Data set bar help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:data-set-bar: the bar on a data set, its pieces, the Filter / Sort / Settings dialogs and the settings tab.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Filter
entries.text: Opens the filter for this data set: rules on any field (contains, is, starts with, one of, greater than, between, empty…), match all or any, and your saved filters. The badge shows how many rules are on.

entries.title: Sort
entries.text: Opens the sort for this data set: up to a few keys, each A→Z or Z→A, in order, plus your saved sorts. The badge shows how many keys are on.

entries.title: Add key
entries.text: Adds another sort key after the ones already on.

entries.title: Search rows
entries.text: Type to narrow the rows. Every word must appear somewhere in the row (any field, or the one picked next to the box); fuzzy matching forgives small typos and words out of order.

entries.title: Field to search
entries.text: Narrows the search to one field of the data set. All fields is the default.

entries.title: Clear
entries.text: Takes the search, every rule and the sort off this data set in one tap. The rows show as they came.

entries.title: Data set bar settings
entries.text: Opens this attachment's settings: which bar asset it draws from, where it sits, which pieces are on, its look, Reset to default and Detach. Right-click the data set for the same block.

entries.title: Match all
entries.text: A row has to pass every rule to show.

entries.title: Match any
entries.text: A row shows when it passes any one rule.

entries.title: Field
entries.text: The column or field this rule looks at.

entries.title: Rule
entries.text: How the rule compares: contains, is, starts with, ends with, is one of, greater / less than, between, empty or not empty. Numbers and dates compare by value.

entries.title: Value
entries.text: What the rule compares the field to. A rule with no value doesn't filter anything yet (its box shows dashed).

entries.title: From
entries.text: The low end of a between rule (either order works).

entries.title: To
entries.text: The high end of a between rule.

entries.title: Values
entries.text: For is one of: the values that pass, separated by commas.

entries.title: Rule on
entries.text: Switch a rule off to keep it without applying it.

entries.title: Remove rule
entries.text: Deletes this rule.

entries.title: Add rule
entries.text: Adds a rule on the first field; pick the field, how it compares and the value. The filter-button asset caps how many rules a filter may hold.

entries.title: Add rule
entries.text: Adds a rule on the first field; pick the field, how it compares and the value.

entries.title: Clear filter
entries.text: Removes the search text and every rule (the sort stays).

entries.title: Save the current filter as
entries.text: Name the rules and search as they are now; it joins the saved filters of this data set on this device. Saving the same name again replaces it.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Keeps the current filter (or sort) under the name typed.

entries.title: Move key up
entries.text: Sorts by this key before the one above it.

entries.title: Move key down
entries.text: Sorts by this key after the one below it.

entries.title: Add a sort key
entries.text: Pick a field to sort by after the keys already on. Tap a key's direction to flip it; empties always go last.

entries.title: Save the current sort as
entries.text: Name the sort keys as they are now; it joins the saved sorts of this data set on this device.

entries.title: Clear sort
entries.text: Removes every sort key; the rows show in the data set's own order.

entries.title: Done
entries.text: Closes the dialog. Everything you changed is already applied and kept.

entries.title: Bar asset
entries.text: The data-set-bar asset this attachment draws from (its pieces, placement and look). Pieces only means no bar asset: the pieces below stand on their own.

entries.title: Placement
entries.text: Where the bar sits on this data set: Top above it, Bottom under it, Inline as one quiet line on its header edge, Floating as a pill you can drag anywhere.

entries.title: Asset's placement
entries.text: Drops this attachment's own placement and goes back to what the bar asset says.

entries.title: Pill starts at
entries.text: Which corner the floating pill appears in until you drag it.

entries.title: Bottom end
entries.text: The pill starts at the bottom end corner.

entries.title: Bottom start
entries.text: The pill starts at the bottom start corner.

entries.title: Top end
entries.text: The pill starts at the top end corner.

entries.title: Top start
entries.text: The pill starts at the top start corner.

entries.title: Put the pill back
entries.text: Forgets where you dragged the floating pill; it goes back to its starting corner.

entries.title: Search bar piece
entries.text: Switch the search piece on or off for this data set and pick which search-bar asset it is (the same type as the top-bar search, scoped to this data set).

entries.title: Filter button piece
entries.text: Switch the filter piece on or off and pick which filter-button asset it is.

entries.title: Sort control piece
entries.text: Switch the sort piece on or off and pick which sort-control asset it is (menu, chips or buttons).

entries.title: Row count
entries.text: Shows how many rows are shown out of the whole data set, e.g. 12 of 40.

entries.title: Clear button
entries.text: Shows a Clear button on the bar while anything is applied.

entries.title: Align
entries.text: Where the pieces sit along the bar.

entries.title: Start
entries.text: Pieces from the start of the bar.

entries.title: Center
entries.text: Pieces in the middle of the bar.

entries.title: End
entries.text: Pieces at the end of the bar.

entries.title: Spread
entries.text: Pieces spread across the whole bar.

entries.title: Density
entries.text: How much room the bar takes: compact or regular.

entries.title: Compact
entries.text: The tighter bar.

entries.title: Regular
entries.text: The roomier bar.

entries.title: Surface
entries.text: The bar's background: flat on the page, raised with a shadow, or glass (see-through).

entries.title: Flat
entries.text: No background of its own.

entries.title: Raised
entries.text: A raised surface with a shadow.

entries.title: Glass
entries.text: A see-through glass surface.

entries.title: Reset to default
entries.text: Back to the bar asset's own look and placement with nothing applied. Your saved filters and sorts stay.

entries.title: Detach
entries.text: Takes the data set bar and every piece off this data set. Its saved filters and sorts go with it; the asset is untouched.

entries.title: Open a grid to attach to
entries.text: Opens a page with a grid. Right-click any grid, list, tree or table there → Attach data set bar.

entries.title: Registry Browser
entries.text: Opens the asset registry. Right-click a data-set-bar, search-bar, filter-button or sort-control card → Attach to data set.

entries.title: Data set bar
entries.text: The plugin's settings: which data sets have a bar on this device, what a plain attach uses, and every look.

entries.title: Settings
entries.text: Opens this attachment's settings dialog.

entries.title: Reset to default
entries.text: Back to the asset's look and placement for this data set, nothing applied; saved filters and sorts stay.

entries.title: Detach
entries.text: Takes the bar off this data set.

entries.title: Attach to
entries.text: Pick a data set seen since the app started (ones on screen first) to attach the bar to.

entries.title: Attach
entries.text: Attaches the bar to the picked data set with the picked placement (or the asset's own).

entries.title: Bar asset for a plain attach
entries.text: Which data-set-bar asset a plain Attach data set bar uses (right-click, voice, API).

entries.title: Search bar piece
entries.text: Which dataset-scoped search-bar asset Attach piece → Search bar uses.

entries.title: Filter button piece
entries.text: Which filter-button asset Attach piece → Filter button uses.

entries.title: Sort control piece
entries.text: Which sort-control asset Attach piece → Sort control uses.

entries.title: Back to the framework defaults
entries.text: Forgets these picks: the default bar, its own placement, and the default piece assets.

entries.title: Show every look
entries.text: Shows every data-set-bar asset drawn over no data set, so the looks can be compared: full bar, compact inline line, floating pill, footer.

entries.title: Attach data set bar
entries.text: Attaches the bar to the data set you right-clicked, where you picked: Top, Bottom, Inline or Floating. Nothing shows on a data set until it is attached.

entries.title: Attach piece
entries.text: Attaches just a search bar, a filter button or a sort control to the data set, without the whole bar.

entries.title: Detach data set bar
entries.text: Takes the bar and every piece off the data set.

entries.title: Detach piece
entries.text: Takes one piece off the data set; when nothing is left the attachment goes too.

entries.title: Move
entries.text: Moves the bar to Top, Bottom, Inline or Floating on this data set.

entries.title: Change bar
entries.text: Draws this data set's bar from another data-set-bar asset.

entries.title: Reset to default
entries.text: Back to the asset's own look and placement, nothing applied; saved filters and sorts stay.

entries.title: Clear
entries.text: Takes the search, rules and sort off this data set.

entries.title: Settings…
entries.text: Opens this attachment's settings dialog.

entries.title: Filter…
entries.text: Opens the filter dialog for this data set.

entries.title: Sort…
entries.text: Opens the sort dialog for this data set.

entries.title: List data set bars
entries.text: Shows every data set with a bar on this device, with placement and what is applied.

entries.title: Data set bar
entries.text: Opens the plugin's settings under Settings → Plugins.
